analyst_view.overall: A relegation six-pointer: Mainz (13th, 10 points) have lost five competitive games in a row, the latest 3-1 at Augsburg after which fans whistled the team, and Urs Fischer said they get what they deserve. Union (17th, 7 points) were beaten 5-1 at home by Leipzig and Berlin papers call this an 'Endspiel' for coach Mauro Lustrinelli, a former assistant of Fischer's; Union have conceded 26 goals in 10 games, the worst at this stage in their Bundesliga history. Union are without six players: Van den Bosch (fifth yellow) and Juranovic are in the numbers, but vice-captain Rani Khedira (hurt against Leipzig) and centre-back Felix Uduokhai (injured since Augsburg) are not, and Nsoki and Skov are long-term absentees; top scorer Andrej Ilic has lost his voice but should play. Mainz news was thin; their listed absentees (Kohr, Silas, Ruoppi) are in the numbers, as is referee Timo Gerach (4.4 cards a game). I lean a little higher on goals, shots and cards.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals and already add for Van den Bosch's ban (about +6% to Mainz), take off for Juranovic (-8% to Union) and count the head-to-head. They don't know that Union's defence also loses Khedira and Uduokhai, which leaves a back line that has conceded 2.6 a game even thinner, so I add 4%, to about 3.1.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners, with Mainz expected to have more (5.9) at home, and they already count Union's low recent corner count (20 in six). Union have switched between a back four and a back five without changing how much they attack down the flanks, so I stay at 9.8.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.1 cards; they already add about 12% for referee Timo Gerach (4.4 cards a game) and a little for both sides' recent bookings (Union 17 in six). They don't count the stakes: 13th against 17th, both on losing runs and Union's coach reportedly playing for his job, which points to a nervy, physical game, so I add 4%, to about 5.3.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.1 shots and already add about 12% to Mainz for how many shots Union have been conceding (110 in six). With Khedira and Uduokhai also missing from Union's defence, which the numbers don't know, Mainz should find a little more room, so I add 3%, to about 28.9.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.0 shots on target. Mainz have been conceding plenty on target and Union create little, both already in the numbers; the extra gaps in Union's defence without Khedira and Uduokhai add a little for Mainz, so I go to about 9.3.
